roberta_textcnn.description: Token states of the encoder, three 1-D convolutions (kernel 3/4/5, 100 filters each), masked max pooling, linear layer.
roberta_textcnn.evaluation: dev and test recomputed on CPU in float32 with thesis1/evaluate.py; expected_test is the score printed by the training notebook (GPU, float16 autocast); expected_dev is the notebook dev score of the selected epoch, rounded to 4 decimals.
roberta_textcnn.source: Thesis 1 data-fixed run (notebook fyp-training-data-fixed-local.ipynb): data read with QUOTE_NONE (27,766 / 2,000 / 5,000 rows), seed 42 set once before the models were trained in sequence. Original weight file textcnn_best.pth.

roberta_bigru.description: Token states of the encoder, 2-layer bidirectional GRU (256 per direction), GRU output at the last real token, linear layer.
roberta_bigru.evaluation: dev and test recomputed on CPU in float32 with thesis1/evaluate.py; expected_test is the score printed by the training notebook (GPU, float16 autocast); expected_dev is the notebook dev score of the selected epoch, rounded to 4 decimals.
roberta_bigru.source: Thesis 1 data-fixed run (notebook fyp-training-data-fixed-local.ipynb): data read with QUOTE_NONE (27,766 / 2,000 / 5,000 rows), seed 42 set once before the models were trained in sequence. Original weight file bigru_best.pth.

roberta_linear.description: [CLS] state of the encoder, linear layer.
roberta_linear.evaluation: dev and test recomputed on CPU in float32 with thesis1/evaluate.py; expected_test is the score printed by the training notebook (GPU, float16 autocast); expected_dev is the notebook dev score of the selected epoch, rounded to 4 decimals.
roberta_linear.source: Thesis 1 data-fixed run (notebook fyp-training-data-fixed-local.ipynb): data read with QUOTE_NONE (27,766 / 2,000 / 5,000 rows), seed 42 set once before the models were trained in sequence. Original weight file roberta_linear_best.pth.

roberta_bigru_attention.description: Gated fusion of the [CLS] state and the projected BiGRU state, linear layer; trained with cross-entropy only (lambda = 0).
roberta_bigru_attention.evaluation: dev and test recomputed on CPU in float32 with thesis1/evaluate.py; expected_test is the score printed by the training notebook (GPU, float16 autocast); expected_dev is the notebook dev score of the selected epoch, rounded to 4 decimals.
roberta_bigru_attention.source: Thesis 1 corrected ablation run (notebook fyp-training-corrected-ablation.ipynb): data read with QUOTE_NONE, optimiser includes the attention and projection layers, seed 42 reset before each arm. Arm lambda = 0 (no topological regulariser).

roberta_bigru_attention_topo.description: Same architecture as RoBERTa-BiGRU-Attention; trained with cross-entropy plus the topological regulariser on the batch of predicted distributions (lambda = 0.15). This is the full Thesis 1 model.
roberta_bigru_attention_topo.evaluation: dev and test recomputed on CPU in float32 with thesis1/evaluate.py; expected_test is the score printed by the training notebook (GPU, float16 autocast); expected_dev is the notebook dev score of the selected epoch, rounded to 4 decimals.
roberta_bigru_attention_topo.source: Thesis 1 corrected ablation run (notebook fyp-training-corrected-ablation.ipynb): data read with QUOTE_NONE, optimiser includes the attention and projection layers, seed 42 reset before each arm. Arm lambda = 0.15 (with the topological regulariser).
